outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic diagrams and micrographs illustrating image cropping/rotation; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel b shows schematic and micrograph images illustrating image spacing, not a plot with averages.
Panel c shows micrographs illustrating insets/zooms, not a plot with averages.
Panel d shows a schematic and micrographs of brightness/contrast adjustment, not a data plot.
Panel e shows schematic circles and micrographs illustrating channel annotation, not a data plot.
Panel f shows schematic and micrographs illustrating grayscale channels, not a data plot.
Panel g shows micrographs with calibration/intensity scale bars, not a plot of averaged quantitative data with individual points.
